newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's HACTL throughput up 6.6 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's HACTL throughput up 6.6 pct in 1996.

text.p: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd (HACTL) said on Monday its throughput rose 6.6 percent to 1.489 million tonnes last year, compared with 1995.
HACTL said in a statement it was the highest yearly total registered in its 21-year operating history at Hong Kong's Kai Tak airport.
Exports climbed 6.3 percent to 703,522 tonnes compared with 1995, while imports upped 7.6 percent to 607,594 tonnes.
Transhipments rose 4.6 percent to 178,032 tonnes, it said.
"HACTL has ambitiously planned to significantly increase its freight handling capacity to 2.6 million tonnes per annum at Chek Lap Kok," HACTL managing director Anthony Charter said.
"The construction of our new terminal is progressing and we are looking forward to providing even higher standards of service when the new airport opens in 1998," he said.

HACTL also said it had improved its reliability in 1996. Out of a total of 2.507 million consignments handled on 157,335 flights, only 89 -- one in 28,178 consignments -- were reported mishandled throughout the year. It did not give comparative figure in 1995.

The group is 25 percent held by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd, 20 percent by Swire Pacific Ltd, 12.5 percent by Wharf (Holdings) Ltd, 12.5 percent by Hutchinson Whampoa Ltd and 10 percent each by CITIC Pacific Ltd, China National Aviation Corp and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd.
